Game ID Wall - W0

This is an isolated feasibility prototype for the Game ID Wall, not the product. It contains only sample content: no accounts, no real profiles, no connections, no saving, no backend. Nothing you do here is stored anywhere except (optionally) this browser. It is not linked from GamID and is not indexed.

Open first (on your phone)

1. EditorEdit one 9:16 stage at a time. Drag, pinch, resize, group, layers, text styling, backgrounds, embeds. Use the Overview and Preview buttons at the top. 2. Hosting shape A - top-level Wall (with simulated Intro)The Wall is the page. Normal scrolling. YouTube / Spotify load only when tapped. 3. Hosting shape B - Wall inside an outer iframeSame Wall framed by another page (players nested one level deeper). Compare scrolling, fullscreen, touch, URL bar. 4. Embed size labReal YouTube / Spotify players at chosen box sizes. Load on tap, destroy on demand. 5. Same Wall at 360 / 390 / 412 / 768 / desktop 560 / 640 / 720Emulated widths in frames (desktop use).

What this prototype must NOT be mistaken for

  • Not the production Wall, not a template system, no publishing, no QR, no persistence.
  • The Intro here is a small simulation of scroll-lock and reveal, not the real Intro engine.
  • GamID blocks show FAKE sample data and are labelled so.
  • Desktop and emulated results do not prove phone behaviour; a real iPhone has not been tested at all.

Full manual test sequence: see README.md in the prototype folder of the repository.
